cases.title: Common host compromise
cases.prospectiveSafety: May expose all witness and worker secrets; distinct process keys do not protect host
cases.prospectiveAvailability: No independent-host resilience claim

cases.title: Storage withholds or corrupts synthetic data
cases.prospectiveSafety: Ledger permission does not prove delivery or real payload authenticity
cases.prospectiveAvailability: Withholding can prevent completion

cases.title: Adversarial durable database rollback
cases.prospectiveSafety: Erasing prior signing choices invalidates durable single-signing assumption; classify separately from logical process restart
cases.prospectiveAvailability: Corrupt state must not silently reset identity; exact fail-closed behavior needs owner specification

cases.title: Authority removal across checkpoint barrier
cases.prospectiveSafety: Under C0/D-a proposal: PBC credential validation gives UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY after removal. A previously issued decision tied to the old authEpoch can still grant before the DBC accepts a new-epoch checkpoint if all other checks/expiries hold; afterward STALE_STATE. Window bounded by checkpoint TTL and decision expiry <= checkpoint expiry.
cases.prospectiveAvailability: Global authEpoch change invalidates in-flight PBC requests and, after the barrier, old-epoch decisions; unrelated issuers share the availability cost.
cases.historicalLedgerEvidence: Proposed extension; no governance or F execution
dependencies: Exact remove/re-add/history semantics and ledger design revision
Agreed checkpoint timing and witness validation

cases.title: Expired unexecuted governance nonce or checkpoint sequence
cases.prospectiveSafety: Expired governance action cannot execute (EXPIRED subject to earlier check precedence). Any re-signing must establish old value is no longer acceptable on the relevant ledger; local wall-clock expiry alone is insufficient.
cases.prospectiveAvailability: Strict permanent single-signing can stall an unused nonce/sequence. Safe reuse after expiry remains unresolved; no recovery guarantee is assumed.
